dhp116:1:
Be quick in doing
what’s admirable.
dhp116:2:
Restrain your mind
from what’s evil.
dhp116:3:
When you’re slow
in making merit,
dhp117:2: he shouldn’t do it again & again,
dhp117:3: shouldn’t develop a penchant for it.
dhp118:2: he should do it again & again,
dhp118:3: should develop a penchant for it.
dhp119:1:
Even the evil
meet with good fortune
dhp119:2:
as long as their evil
has yet to mature.
dhp119:4:
that’s when they meet
with evil.
dhp120:1:
Even the good
meet with bad fortune
dhp120:2:
as long as their good
has yet to mature.
dhp120:4:
that’s when they meet
with good fortune.
dhp121:3:
A water jar fills,
even with water
dhp121:6:
bit
by
bit,
habitually–
the fool fills himself full.
dhp122:3:
A water jar fills,
even with water
dhp122:6:
bit
by
bit,
habitually–
the enlightened one fills himself full.
dhp123:2:
Like a merchant with a small
but well-laden caravan
dhp123:4:
like a person who loves life
–a poison,
one should avoid
–evil deeds.
dhp124:1:
If there’s no wound on the hand,
that hand can hold poison.
dhp124:3:
Poison won’t penetrate
where there’s no wound.
dhp124:4:
There’s no evil
for those who don’t do it.
dhp125:3: the evil comes right back to the fool
dhp125:4:
like fine dust
thrown against the wind.
dhp126:1:
Some are born
in the human womb,
dhp126:3:
those on the good course go
to heaven,
dhp126:4:
while those without effluent:
totally unbound.
dhp127:1:
Not up in the air,
nor in the middle of the sea,
dhp127:2: nor going into a cleft in the mountains
dhp127:3:
–nowhere on earth–
is a spot to be found
dhp127:4:
where you could stay & escape
your evil deed.
dhp128:1:
Not up in the air,
nor in the middle of the sea,
dhp128:2: nor going into a cleft in the mountains
dhp128:3:
–nowhere on earth–
is a spot to be found
dhp128:4:
where you could stay & not succumb
to death.
